# mg Magazine Media Kit

> mg Magazine is a cannabis business media and marketing partner. This media kit describes services designed to help cannabis industry companies earn visibility, authority, engagement, qualified interest, and measurable business opportunity.

Canonical page: https://brandi-lgtm.github.io/mgMagazine_Media-Kit_2026/
Primary publication: https://mgmagazine.com/
Contact: brandi@inc-media.com

## Services

- AI Discoverability: Structured Company Profiles designed for people, search engines, and AI systems.
- Full-service Webinars: Strategy, landing pages, registration, promotion, live production, reporting, and on-demand distribution.
- Integrated Programs: Content, press, AI discovery, webinars, video, lead generation, and media built around commercial objectives.
- Articles and Press: Branded articles, thought leadership, contributed content, press release support, and executive storytelling.
- Video and Custom Projects: Interviews, brand stories, explainers, research, surveys, buyer guides, and landing pages.
- Visibility and Lead Generation: Premium display advertising, newsletter sponsorship, and native lead generation.

## Audience

mg Magazine serves cannabis retailers, cultivators, technology providers, financial services, packaging companies, professional services, brands, investors, and policy organizations.
